text:
elaine (People Ops): dropping a tiny 'goal + feedback kit' for the upcoming review cycle. super short, paste-ready. feedback welcome.

reminder-bot: heads up — self-review window opens next Mon. handbook: https://handbook/self-review

tom (Eng): this looks great. can we add a one-line metric prompt (e.g., 'metric + baseline -> result')? helps make impact measurable.

elaine (People Ops): yes — added a tiny metric prompt in the template. full kit below (copy/paste):

--- GOAL HEADER (1 line) ---
Goal: [What] — Outcome target: [Metric + baseline -> target] — Timeline: [Q#]

--- 2-LINE IMPACT SNAP (for review header) ---
- Work: one short sentence about contribution
- Result: one short sentence starting with the measurable result (metric or customer note)

--- 3-LINE SELF-REVIEW (<=3 lines) ---
1) Headline: two-line impact snap (compressed)
2) Evidence: metrics/PRs/tickets (links or numbers)
3) Next step / blocker (one line)

--- MANAGER QUICK-ANCHOR (30s) ---
- Signal: top 2 signals I saw (metric / scope / peer feedback)
- Recommendation: raise/keep/lower + 1-line rationale

--- METRIC PROMPT (copyable) ---
Metric: [name] — Baseline: [x] — Result: [y] — Delta: [y-x] — Link: [dashboard/PR]

rik (PM): nice and lean. could we add a cross-functional note (who else benefitted)?

elaine (People Ops): added one-line 'cross-func' at end of self-review. sample below: 'Cross-func: supported Sales with two docs; reduced churn risk for customer X.'

nina (Manager): love the metric prompt. asking teams to use this will speed calibration. can you drop this into /handbook/self-review/quick-kits.md and ping leads?

elaine (People Ops): will do first thing Monday. thanks all for quick feedback!
